beats.say: There is also a quiet way to steal an account: a voting link and a hidden linked device.
If you see a notice like this, your account is open on another device too.

body.text: Computer, Ganja. If this was not you, check your linked devices.

beats.say: Do not trust a page that wants your messenger login before you can vote.
Turn on two-step verification and check your linked devices from time to time.

scenes.prompt: Is each notice safe or a threat?

messages.text: Your Söhbət code: 418 205. Do not share this code with anyone.

cards.explain: If you did not ask for it, someone is trying to log in with your number. Give the code to no one.
If you did not link it, someone is reading your chats. Remove it from linked devices right away.

body.text: My daughter is in a drawing contest, please vote:

cards.explain: Voting links are a favourite way to steal accounts. Even if someone you know sends one, do not log in on that page.

body.text: You set up extra protection for your account.

cards.explain: This confirms a step you took yourself. Two-step verification protects the account from code theft.

body.text: Kamran Əhmədov: Tomorrow's meeting is at ten, in room two fourteen.

cards.explain: This is an ordinary work message. It asks for no code, no money and no link.

scenes.title: The drawing contest
scenes.intro: Someone you know asks for votes in a children's drawing contest. Choose the right step on each page.

steps.label: Vote for Leyla's drawing
steps.say: The page looks lovely and has a Vote button.

actions.label: Vote
actions.feedback: The vote button takes you to a login page. You have lost nothing yet, but be careful.

actions.label: Close the page
actions.feedback: Correct. Closing an unknown page that wants an account for a vote is the safest step.

steps.say: It wants you to log in with Söhbət to vote.

actions.label: Enter the number
actions.feedback: With your number the thief requests a code in your name. On the next step they will ask for that code.

actions.label: Close the page
actions.feedback: Correct. The address is not Söhbət's own, so this is a fake login page.

body.text: Type the six-digit Söhbət code sent to your phone.

steps.say: Now it asks you to type the code from your phone on this page.

actions.label: Type the code
actions.feedback: The moment you typed it, your account opened on the thief's phone. A Söhbət code is never typed on a website.

actions.label: Cancel
actions.feedback: Correct. The code is only needed inside the Söhbət app itself, never on a page.

body.text: Open Linked devices in the Söhbət app and enter this code:

steps.say: The page asks for something new: linking a device in the app.

actions.label: Link the device
actions.feedback: You linked the thief's computer to your account. Now they see all your chats.

actions.label: Cancel
actions.feedback: Correct. Voting never requires linking a device.

body.text: Computer, Ganja. Last active: two minutes ago.

steps.say: Just in case, you check linked devices in Söhbət's own settings.

actions.label: Log out
actions.feedback: Correct. Once you log out a device you do not know, it no longer sees your messages.

actions.label: Keep
actions.feedback: You did not link this device. If you keep it, someone will go on reading your chats.

question.prompt: What protects your Söhbət account best against code theft?

options.label: Turning on two-step verification
options.feedback: Correct. Even if the code is stolen, no one gets in without the secret digits you set.

options.label: Hiding your profile photo
options.feedback: Photo privacy is good, but it does not protect the account. Two-step verification does.

options.label: Deleting chats often
options.feedback: This does not stop a thief from getting in. Turn on two-step verification.

scenes.explain: Two-step verification puts a second lock on your account. Only you know it.

scenes.prompt: Match each situation to the right step.

pairs.left: A code you did not ask for

scenes.explain: The code, devices and links are the doors to your account. Control each one yourself and open none to others.

points: Do not log in with Söhbət to vote
On a new device notice, check linked devices
